customManagers.description: Version pins marked with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above: Emscripten in build.yml and the Makefile, Mesa in build.yml
Emscripten versions quoted in the manuals and comments, kept equal to the CI pin (make docs-drift checks this)
raylib source pin: the tag and its commit (also in the archive URL). The sha256 and patches.json need a manual update, so CI fails until a maintainer finishes the bump.
Vendored tomlc17 release. Renovate cannot re-import the sources and re-apply the project patches, so this only reports new releases on the Dependency Dashboard (see vendor/tomlc17/README.md).

packageRules.description: Toolchain and vendored-source pins change generated code or need manual follow-up (checksums, patches), so they are never automerged
One pull request for every Emscripten pin and mention
Mesa and raylib bumps also need a new SHA-256 (MESA_SHA256 in build.yml, sha256 in vendor/raylib/manifest.json); CI fails closed until it is updated
prBodyNotes: Update the pinned SHA-256 for the new archive before merging; the checksum check in CI fails until then.

packageRules.description: tomlc17 is vendored with project patches: report new releases on the Dependency Dashboard only
